summary: Comprehensive architectural, UX, and scientific implementation plan for the SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Tiruchirappalli (Division of Chemistry) Cheminformatics Virtual Laboratory Portal, covering student registration, theoretical foundations, 2D/3D molecular visualization (RDKit/SmilesDrawer + 3Dmol.js + PubChem PUG REST), physicochemical descriptors, multi-molecule structure-property analysis, interactive assessment, and automated PDF lab report generation.
